_language_note: This file illustrates the shape server.py's make_approved()/normalize_language() actually produce. 'approved-story-v1-en-only' shows what every v1 approval looks like today: source_language is always 'en', localizations is always {} — nothing here is auto-translated or pre-populated. 'approved-story-v2-illustrative-only' is NOT real/current behavior — it shows the future shape a localization entry will have once a translation stage exists, purely so the schema is documented consistently. Do not treat the second record as active data; v1 never writes anything into localizations.
